# Compatibility API

`run_mixedgp_experiment()` is retained for existing examples and historical
workflows. The paper's frozen publication design uses the newer study-specific
runners in the next chapter.

```{r copy-legacy-experiment-api, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
source_file <- file.path(
  repository_dir, "script", "newly-written-and-modified-scripts",
  "reproduction_compat.R"
)
target_file <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "R", basename(source_file))
stopifnot(file.copy(source_file, target_file, overwrite = TRUE))
stopifnot(identical(
  unname(tools::md5sum(source_file)), unname(tools::md5sum(target_file))
))
```

```{r install-legacy-experiment-resources, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
source_dir <- file.path(
  repository_dir, "script", "newly-written-and-modified-scripts"
)
legacy_resources <- c(
  "01_study1_representative_figures.R",
  "02_study1_monte_carlo.R",
  "02_study1_targeted_controls.R",
  "04_study1_ablations.R",
  "01_study2_representative_figures.R",
  "02_study2_monte_carlo.R",
  "04_study2_ablations.R"
)
legacy_dir <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "inst", "experiments")
dir.create(legacy_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
copied <- file.copy(
  file.path(source_dir, legacy_resources),
  file.path(legacy_dir, legacy_resources),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
stopifnot(all(copied))
```
